brandStory.title: Resilient as the Snowdrop
brandStory.subtitle: Eirlys — A symbol of quiet inner strength and rebirth
paragraphs: Modern women's skin moves through an exhausting 24-hour cycle with barely a moment's rest. By day, it stands alone against dust, UV rays and blue light that wear down its natural barrier. By night, stress and sleepless hours lock away the skin's own ability to heal — a relentless loop that leaves skin not just aging, but overloaded and deeply fatigued.
brandStory.quote: In the harshest depths of winter, when everything else freezes beneath the snow, one flower quietly pushes through thick ice to reach the sun — the Snowdrop (Eirlys). Beneath its fragile white petals lies extraordinary inner strength.
afterQuoteParagraphs: Continuously renewing itself to grow through the cold, day and night — much like the modern woman: however much pressure she faces, within her remains a pure spirit and a quiet longing to shine.

Elysiderm was born from that same empathy — and takes the name Eirlys' for its product line, as a daily reminder of that quiet resilience. We're building a scientific skin care ecosystem that works with the skin's natural rhythm to awaken radiance from the cellular level — not through complicated routines, but through focused, powerful solutions that walk beside you every step of the way.

founderLetter.title: A Letter From Our Founder
founderLetter.salutation: To the proud women of Elysiderm,
paragraphs: I'm writing this thinking of a busy morning in a big city, where you're getting ready to step out and conquer new heights. Amid that rush, I know your skin is quietly fighting its own "harsh winter" — time pressure, lost sleep, pollution and stress.

As someone working in dermatological science, and someone who walks alongside women, I kept asking myself: how could I bring the most effective, most urgent, most effortless solution — one that gives modern women back their radiance instantly, while still nurturing their skin's inner strength?

The answer came to me on a trip through the depths of winter, when I saw the Snowdrops. Beneath the thick, freezing snow, while everything else lay dormant, this fragile, snow-white flower still pushed through the ice to reach the sun — needing no shelter, generating its own energy to be reborn and shine. That was the moment Elysiderm was born.
founderLetter.quote: With Elysiderm, skin care isn't meant to be complicated — it's an act of self-love. However demanding life gets, never settle for tired skin.
founderLetter.closing: Let Elysiderm walk with you, so you can always shine with quiet, proud confidence — like a snowdrop blooming bright against the frost.
founderLetter.signOff: With all my respect and affection,
